senses.gloss: The twenty-third consonant of the Nāgarī Alphabet, corresponding to the letter B, and often confounded with the analogous semivowel ब or V, with which some grammarians consider it to be at all times optionally interchangeable.

m. (-बः)
1 A name of VARUṆA.
2 A water jar.
E.
बण to sound, &c. aff. ड.

ind.
1 As, like.
2 Or, either: see वा.
